chairman.name: Sandeep Tyagi
chairman.title: Chairman, SKIE Academy
chairman.message: Education is the most powerful tool you can possess, and at SKIE, we strive to sharpen that tool every day. When we started this institute, our goal was simple: to create a place where students don't just learn syntax and code, but learn how to solve real-world problems. I am proud to say that under the guidance of our expert faculty, hundreds of students have transformed their careers. My promise to you is simple—you bring the dedication, and we will provide the guidance, infrastructure, and opportunities you need to succeed.

courses.name: ADCA (Advance Diploma in Computer Applications)
courses.shortDesc: Comprehensive 1-year master diploma covering computer basics, MS Office, Advanced Excel, Tally Prime + GST, Graphic Design, Web Design, and Internet applications.
courses.fullDesc: The Advance Diploma in Computer Applications (ADCA) is SKIE Academy's flagship 12-month program. Designed for students seeking complete IT literacy and practical workplace skills, this course transforms beginners into proficient office executives, accounting professionals, and graphic operators.
curriculum: Module 2: MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access)
Module 3: Advanced Excel & Data Analysis (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Dashboards)
Module 4: Tally Prime with GST Accounting & Taxation
Module 6: HTML, CSS & Web Design Fundamentals
Module 7: Internet, Cyber Security & Digital Office Tools

courses.name: DCA (Diploma in Computer Applications)
courses.shortDesc: 6-month practical diploma focusing on essential computer applications, office automation, internet literacy, and desktop publishing.
courses.fullDesc: DCA is ideal for school/college students and job seekers looking for a recognized 6-month computer diploma. Gain hands-on expertise in office tools, document creation, data formatting, and digital communications.
curriculum: Module 1: Fundamental Concepts of Computers & Hardware
Module 7: Internet Banking, E-governance & Email Writing

courses.name: Tally Prime with GST & Financial Accounting
courses.shortDesc: Master computerized accounting, GST returns, voucher entry, inventory management, e-invoicing, and payroll in Tally Prime.
courses.fullDesc: Learn practical business accounting from certified industry accounting experts. This course covers everything from debit/credit fundamentals to live GST filing, e-way bills, TDS, and balance sheet finalization in Tally Prime.
curriculum: Company Creation & Group Ledger Setup in Tally Prime
Voucher Entry (Payment, Receipt, Sales, Purchase, Journal)
GST Setup, Tax Invoicing & E-Way Bills
courses.eligibility: 10th/12th Commerce or any stream with basic computer knowledge

courses.name: Advanced Excel & Business Analytics
courses.shortDesc: Master formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query, Macros, data cleaning, and dynamic interactive dashboards.
courses.fullDesc: Excel is the #1 tool required in modern corporate offices. Elevate your spreadsheet skills to an expert level with automated reporting, data visualization, conditional formatting, and dashboard building.
curriculum: Advanced Lookup Functions (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH)
Logical & Text Functions (IF, AND, OR, CONCAT, TEXTJOIN)
Introduction to Excel Macros & Automation Basics

courses.name: Web Development & Frontend Design
courses.shortDesc: Build responsive modern websites using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, and GitHub.
courses.fullDesc: Kickstart your coding career with hands-on web development training. Learn to code clean, mobile-responsive websites, interactive UI components, and host live sites on GitHub Pages and Netlify.
curriculum: CSS3 Flexbox, Grid, Animations & Media Queries

courses.name: Special Computer Skills for Female Students
courses.shortDesc: Empowering women with practical digital literacy, typing, office administration, internet safety, and work-from-home skills.
courses.fullDesc: A dedicated, comfortable learning program tailored specifically for female students, homemakers, and working women to gain financial independence through practical computer skills and digital office training.

courses.name: Nursery Teacher Training (NTT) & Computer Teacher Training
courses.shortDesc: Professional diploma program for aspiring nursery school teachers and school computer instructors with pedagogical methods.
courses.fullDesc: Comprehensive teacher training program combining early childhood education pedagogy, child psychology, school administration, and modern digital teaching methods.

courses.name: Python Programming & Data Science Fundamentals
courses.shortDesc: Learn Python syntax, Object-Oriented Programming, Pandas, NumPy, and Data Visualization.
courses.fullDesc: Step into the world of software development and AI with Python. Build console applications, data analysis scripts, and automate daily tasks.
